'''UTT-90''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the service of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] as a [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]]. Like all B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], UTT-90 had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]],<ref name="GB" /> stood 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="Databank" /> and was equipped with an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Equipment" /> The droid had [[Color/Legends|light tan]] plating with brown markings, and had a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] with an [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
UTT-90 appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' as a unit that could be placed in the game's scenario editor. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] has an identical profile image and model to other unique battle droid units. When placed in a scenario, UTT-90's model uses different colors from their profile image, featuring the tan color common to other B1-Series battle droids on their head and parts of their [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] along with the color selected by the player's alignment on their chest and legs. UTT-90's name can also be mentioned as a commander for the Trade Federation [[Wikipedia:Artificial intelligence in video games|AI]] in the standard game mode.<ref name="GB" />
